scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** an empty-cache browser loads the showcase root and does not navigate to fidelity material
- **THEN** no network request is made for a generated source-reference SVG or the complete fidelity-reference manifest
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::Audit-only references stay outside the initial request set::Load the root page without requesting fidelity evidence
scenarios.name: Load the root page without requesting fidelity evidence
scenarios.requirement: Audit-only references stay outside the initial request set
scenarios.requirementContent: The showcase SHALL NOT request generated source-reference SVGs or the complete fidelity-reference manifest during an empty-cache root load before deferred documentation is requested. When deferred documentation is requested, every reference and evidence fixture available before this change SHALL remain reachable.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a deferred module request fails and the user activates retry after the resource becomes available
- **THEN** the error is cleared, the section loads once, and its existing navigation target and interactive behavior are restored
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::Deferred loading communicates progress and failure::A requested section fails and is retried
scenarios.name: A requested section fails and is retried
scenarios.requirement: Deferred loading communicates progress and failure
scenarios.requirementContent: The showcase SHALL expose a named, non-blocking loading state while a requested section is in flight and an actionable error state if the section cannot load. Retrying SHALL not duplicate successfully initialized content or event handlers.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a section request has not completed
- **THEN** the section boundary communicates its busy state without moving focus unexpectedly or hiding the usable shell
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::Deferred loading communicates progress and failure::A requested section is loading
scenarios.name: A requested section is loading
scenarios.requirement: Deferred loading communicates progress and failure

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the repository builds and packs the public SHLZ packages after the showcase optimization
- **THEN** their export surfaces and package-consumer smoke behavior remain unchanged because showcase-only chunks are not public package inputs
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::Loading improvements are reproducible and budgeted::Build consumer packages
scenarios.name: Build consumer packages
scenarios.requirement: Loading improvements are reproducible and budgeted
scenarios.requirementContent: The repository SHALL generate a deterministic production-build report that distinguishes entry/initial assets from deferred assets and binds measurements to the candidate build. Relative to the clean current-main baseline captured before implementation, the candidate SHALL reduce uncompressed initial JavaScript by at least 30 percent, SHALL introduce no initial source-reference requests, and SHALL NOT increase initial CSS or font transfer bytes by more than 2 percent.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the measurement command runs against the recorded baseline and candidate production builds
- **THEN** it reports comparable asset identities and byte totals, verifies the required reduction and ceilings, and fails on missing, stale, or mismatched build evidence
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::Loading improvements are reproducible and budgeted::Measure the clean baseline and candidate
scenarios.name: Measure the clean baseline and candidate

scenarios.requirementContent: The repository SHALL generate a deterministic production-build report that distinguishes entry/initial assets from deferred assets and binds measurements to the candidate build. scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** focused snapshots are captured for the initial shell, loading state, error state, and representative loaded documentation
- **THEN** source-backed component rendering remains unchanged and the shell does not shift unexpectedly when deferred content is inserted
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::Progressive loading preserves showcase behavior::Compare focused visuals
scenarios.name: Compare focused visuals
scenarios.requirementContent: The showcase SHALL preserve keyboard navigation, focus behavior, typography switching, responsive layout, search, existing component interactions, and visual fidelity for loaded content. Loading a deferred section SHALL not cause an avoidable layout shift above its reserved boundary.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** automated browser checks use the shell and representative deferred interactive components across desktop, narrow viewport, keyboard-only, and enlarged-text conditions
- **THEN** the checks pass with stable focus, usable navigation, no duplicate enhancement, and no scope-local accessibility regression
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::Progressive loading preserves showcase behavior::Exercise representative behavior before and after loading
scenarios.name: Exercise representative behavior before and after loading
scenarios.requirementContent: The showcase SHALL preserve keyboard navigation, focus behavior, typography switching, responsive layout, search, existing component interactions, and visual fidelity for loaded content. Loading a deferred section SHALL not cause an avoidable layout shift above its reserved boundary.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a user activates a showcase navigation link whose target is not loaded
- **THEN** the corresponding section is loaded, rendered, enhanced once, and brought into view without requiring a page reload
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::Requested sections load on demand::Follow a navigation link to a deferred section
scenarios.name: Follow a navigation link to a deferred section
scenarios.requirementContent: The showcase SHALL load and render a deferred section when it is requested through navigation, search, or a direct hash. A successful load SHALL preserve the existing section identifier and SHALL initialize that section's interactive examples exactly once.

- **THEN** the owning section is loaded before hash-target reveal and the target remains addressable by its existing identifier

- **THEN** the owning section is loaded and the requested result receives the same navigation treatment as an already-rendered result

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a user opens the showcase root on an empty cache
- **THEN** the shell, navigation, search, and foundations become available before any deferred documentation section is required
scenarios.id: showcase/loading-performance::The initial showcase shell is independently usable::Open the showcase without a section hash
scenarios.name: Open the showcase without a section hash
scenarios.requirement: The initial showcase shell is independently usable
scenarios.requirementContent: The showcase SHALL render its header, primary navigation, search control, and above-the-fold foundations without waiting for deferred component, consumer, or fidelity modules. The initial shell SHALL expose meaningful content and SHALL NOT substitute a blank page or full-screen loading gate.
